(contract 1 structural-roundtrip
  (input (xs (List I64)) (a I64))
  (output (p (Pair (List I64) I64)))
  (define identity Bool true)
  (program [ pair ])
  (requires (def identity))
  (ensures (and (eq (first (out p)) (in xs))
                (eq (second (out p)) (in a)))))
